headline: AUD is the desk's short: sell AUDCHF and buy EURAUD on a pullback after the Australian jobs miss, plus a CN50 short for risk-off outside FX.
market_summary: The USD is strong on the daily trend (DXY daily RSI 70) but has paused on 4H, and JPY and CHF are firm as VIX sits near 25 and equity indices are oversold. AUD is the clear laggard on every lens: Oct employment -43.5K vs +25K forecast, Lagging on both RRG timeframes, the deepest COT short (Composite 0, still building) and 20-bar-low breakdowns across AUD pairs. All four analysts agreed AUD weakness is the main theme, but AUDUSD, AUDJPY, AUDCAD and AUDNZD are oversold (RSI 17-27), so the desk prefers AUDCHF (RSI 36.8, room left) and a pullback entry in EURAUD. AUD shorts should be closed or cut before AUD CPI on Wed 25 Nov 07:30.

horizon_view.3d: Best horizon: a break of 0.56054 opens 0.5585, with the COT spread at -100 and the AUD jobs miss still being priced.
horizon_view.5d: Extension to 0.5560 is possible, but take profit before Wed 25 Nov 07:30 AUD CPI.

ideas.thesis: The only trade all four lenses back. AUD is at a building COT bearish extreme against CHF at a bullish extreme (spread -100), the Australian jobs data missed badly, and the 4H outside bar broke the 20-bar low with RSI still at 36.8.

COT: AUD Composite 0 (NC net -151,753, shorts +22,296 wk) vs CHF Composite 100; spread -100, the most extreme on the board.
Flow: retail 71.44% long with longs -119.9 pips; AUD Lagging on 4H and Daily RRG.
Macro: AUD Oct jobs -43.5K vs +25K, unemployment 4.9%; AUD 2y -7.3 bp 1w vs CHF 2y +3.7 bp; VIX 25 favours CHF.
risks: AUD short is crowded at the 52-week floor (NC %K52 0, -43% of OI), so a short-covering spike is possible.
CHF is Lagging on the Daily RRG and the daily AUDCHF trend is mixed; a developing bullish divergence exists on 4H.

ideas.thesis: The cleanest long against the weak AUD: Leading on both RRG timeframes, a 2.6-ATR breakout above the 20-bar and 60-bar high, and a crowd still short. EUR is not USD-driven here, so this diversifies away from the dollar.
evidence: Tech: bullish outside bar, range 2.63 ATR, closed at 88% above the 20-bar high 1.64348; MACD bull cross; price > SMA20 1.6326 > SMA200 1.60891.
COT: EUR Composite 6 and AUD 0, both at bearish extremes; EUR shorts covering (+21,395) while AUD shorts still build, a small tilt to the long.
Flow: RRG Leading on 4H and Daily; retail 33.59% long with shorts -284.9 pips; week z 0.64, not stretched.
Macro: AUD jobs miss is the catalyst; carry (EUR 2y 3.142% vs AUD 4.831%) runs against the long.
risks: Stretched on 4H: RSI 70.1 and weekly VWAP z 3.8, so the limit may not fill or the pullback may run deeper.
Negative carry, and EUR flash PMI (HIGH) Mon 23 Nov 15:30 lands inside the 3d window.
